author: akuya
quote: Rockstar has completely lost its soul with GTA 6. Instead of the fearless, unfiltered satire that made the franchise legendary, we get a sanitized, preachy narrative catering to modern woke checklists and forced feminist tropes. The edgy humor is dead, replaced by safe, corporate-approved storytelling that betrays longtime fans. To make matters worse, the technical performance is a mess. Locking consoles at a sluggish 30 FPS with frequent stutters in dense areas feels unacceptable for a flagship title in 2026. Over a decade of waiting for compromised writing and subpar frame rates—Rockstar truly forgot what made GTA great.
